$schema_doc: Each entry pins an SDK version to the SHA-256 of the canonical jar that
this studio release was tested against. The studio probe computes the
SHA of the installed jar at boot and refuses to admit runs if it does
not match (when STUDIO_SDK_PIN=enforce, the default for non-dev runs).
1. Install the SDK jar in the classpath the studio sees.
3. Add an entry with that exact lowercase hex string.
The lockfile is loaded once at boot; the SHA of the jar reported via
/api/version is the one the probe computed at runtime. Operators compare
the two SHAs to detect silent SDK drift.

pinned_sdks._comment_studio_release: R-VER-002 follow-up (2026-10-11): bumped from v0.2.0-alpha.2 to match gradle.properties:studio.version. The probe (PipelineKRuntimeProbe) computes the SHA of the installed JAR at boot and surfaces it via /api/version; operators compare the two SHAs to detect silent SDK drift. The studio_release tag is metadata-only (it tells operators which Studio release this SDK pin was last validated against).
